classification: Partial revision-specific vendor-PCB-derived preview with generic component models; not manufacturer assembled CAD; not a complete mechanical envelope.
board_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as expressly labeled in companion vendor schematic title blocks; retain Seeed attribution, source links, license and derivative notice.
kicad_model_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 with KiCad library exception; copied model collections retain LICENSE.md and source/author metadata.
grabcad_verdict: Rejected as manufacturer CAD: Seeed wiki links to third-party Maurice Pannard approximations. C3 2023-02-14 predates v1.3; author warns SoC/USB-C/U.FL accuracy. C6 2024-11-06 warns button/U.FL/antenna positional accuracy and omits LEDs/resistors. No explicit per-asset redistribution license verified. No GrabCAD models downloaded.
mating_stack: No preheader SKU, fitted male-header model, measured socket engagement, mating depth or installed module Z is asserted. The export represents a bare PCB-derived reference.

c3.conversion_note: KiCad9 native save may normalize duplicate decorative silkscreen/mask primitives from KiCad8 C6 source. Exact pads, footprint positions/angles, tracks/vias, copper/mechanical drawings, zone outlines and board thickness compare equal; original source retained unchanged.
c3.step_axes: +X USB/right; +Y opposite carrier KiCad Y; +Z top/component side. No XY rotation from source; exporter Y reflection only.
